title: I don't feel well — новые слова

items.example: I don't feel well today — I think I've got flu.
I have stomachache — I ate some fish last night.
I've got a sore throat and I can't swallow.
Have you got anything for a cough?
I've got a runny nose and a temperature.
She's got a high temperature — over 39 degrees.
A cold starts slowly. Flu starts suddenly.
After flu you often feel tired for three weeks.
I've got terrible toothache — I need a dentist.
I woke up this morning with earache.
My back hurts after eight hours at the desk.
You broke a glass and cut your thumb badly.
I have a sprained wrist from playing tennis.
You shouldn't take antibiotics for a cold.
The doctor gave me a prescription for tablets.
In a pharmacy you can buy tablets and cream without a prescription.
You should go to the doctor if you have a high temperature.
Could I have some plasters for my finger?
